visualReview.method: Local full PNG and 512px JPEG inspection, plus decoded RGB pixel comparison to the ancestor wall.

unmetRequirements: Fine rock texture within the addition patch is not identical to the ancestor; all pixels outside the patch are identical.
The explicitly required beside-record JPEG is in dist/line-2 rather than artifacts/, following the existing accepted layout despite the conflicting blanket image-location rule.
toolLimitations: The supplied block hash still requires independent chain, canonicality and finality authentication.
Demo checkpoints are historical RPC observations, not consensus-verified checkpoints.
Supported execution header schemas end at Prague; unknown fields fail closed.
